The '''throne room''' of the [[Emperor Palpatine Surgical Reconstruction Center]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] served as the public seat of the [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] from the foundation of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] at the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Serving only as a temporary home for the throne while the [[Imperial Throne Room|formal residence]] was prepared at the newly named [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Imperial Palace]], Emperor [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] vacated the throne room upon moving to the Palace.

==History==
Following [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] [[Declaration of a New Order]], recently-titled [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] Palpatine moved his residence to the nearby [[Emperor Palpatine Surgical Reconstruction Center]]; a secretive facility atop the [[Coruscant Medical]] tower.<ref name="DL" />

Meeting with members of the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]] and his [[Imperial Ruling Council/Legends|Imperial Ruling Council]], the Emperor made use of the throne room extensively during his first year of galactic ruler. Use of the facility was not to be permanent; Palpatine had already begun construction on his new [[Imperial Throne Room|throne room]] at the nearby [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Imperial Palace]] and, upon its completion, would take up residence within.<ref name="DL" />

==Layout==
Constructed below the [[Emperor Palpatine Surgical Reconstruction Center]] in the upper levels of the [[Coruscant Medical]] tower, the Emperor's throne room was a long and narrow chamber that resembled the [[Chancellor's working office/Legends|holding office]] located below the [[Grand Convocation Chamber]] in the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Rotunda]]. A wide but short burnished staircase bisected the room into two levels, with the upper level dais replete with long [[permaplas]] windows. A pair of the [[Emperor's Royal Guard/Legends|Emperor's Royal Guards]] were to stand at attention at the staircase's foot. Behind the Guard stations was a table for Palpatine to meet with his [[Imperial Advisor/Legends|Imperial Advisors]], and behind that table stood his large mechanized throne, integrated with the building's communications and computer systems.<ref name="DL" />

As his old [[Chancellor's Suite/Legends|offices]] were in ruins in the [[Republic Executive Building/Legends|Republic Executive Building]], Palpatine ordered the removal of most of his [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] statuary and artwork and had it transferred to his new throne room. Flanking the door and windows were the [[Bronzium/Legends|bronzium]] statues of the [[Four Sages of Dwartii/Legends|Four Sages of Dwartii]] and the [[Great Hyperspace War Bas-Relief|Massassi frieze]] recounting the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]] adorned the walls. Directly above the throne room in the restricted Reconstruction Center was the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith's]] [[Palpatine's meditation chamber/Legends|private meditation chamber]] and repositories of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] knowledge banks.<ref name="DL" />
